name: BarChart
description: Presentational Chart.js bar chart. Data must be pre-aggregated; use grouped or stacked categories via `datasets`

props.name: data
props.description: Chart data - required, provided by parent. Use `as any` for mixed bar+line datasets

props.name: isStacked
props.description: Stack bars on top of each other

props.name: legendAlign
props.description: Alignment of the legend labels within their position

props.name: formatDataLabel
props.description: Format data label values (default: round to nearest integer)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Custom HTML tooltip configuration. When provided, replaces the default Chart.js tooltip
